title: Variance of a biased Boolean function
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\{\pm1\}$, and let $0<p<1$. Write $\widehat f(S)$ for the uniform Fourier coefficient of $f$ at $S\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}$, and define $q_f(p)=\frac{1-\sum_{S\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}}(1-2p)^{|S|}\widehat f(S)}{2}$. Then the variance of $f$ under the product distribution with $\Pr[X_i=-1]=p$ independently for each coordinate is $4q_f(p)(1-q_f(p))$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on $n$ coordinates
